name: Planar Binding

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend within range

upcast.text: Lasts 10 days with a level 6 slot, 30 days with level 7, 180 days with level 8 and a year and a day with level 9.

summary: Bind a Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend to serve you: Cha save or it must obey.
text: The target must stay within range for the whole casting (usually held by a summoning circle). On a failed save it serves you for the duration; a creature summoned by another spell has its duration extended to match.
